event.description: EXTERNAL (default -> just don't mention the field), INTERNAL, ATM or IVR

pan.description: Either encryptedPan or pan should be mentioned

panSequenceNumber.description: Either panSequenceNumber or panExpiryDate should be mentioned, or both

panExpiryDate.description: Format MMYY - Either panSequenceNumber or panExpiryDate should be mentioned, or both

pinBlockPan.description: Only for cases where PAN input to PIN block computation should be overriden; either encryptedPinBlockPan or pinBlockPan should be mentioned

algoId.description:
Algorithm used to encrypt Session Key
Allowed Value:
06 for RSA

keyId.description:
Key set used for request
Allowed Value:
01 - Keyset1
02 - Keyset2
Either PCI hexadecimal key index or 01 for BEST/AES-GCM keyset 1 or 02 for BEST/AES-GCM keyset 2

sessionKey.description: BEST session key in hexadecimal string representation

initializationVector.description: BEST or AES-GCM initialization vector in hexadecimal string representation

authenticationTag.description: AES-GCM authentication tag in hexadecimal string representation

keyId.description:
Key set used for response
Allowed Value:
01 - Keyset1
02 - Keyset2

pinAlgorithmId.description:
Algorithm used to encrypt the PIN
Allowed Value:
04 = ISO-4 (=> encryptedSessionKey required)
05 = ISO-1-BAPOF (internal transport + BE banks)
06 = RSA-APAC (deprecated)
07 = BEST-PIN (internal migration)

pinBlock.description: PIN block in hexadecimal string representation

pinBlockFormat.description: ISO-4, ISO-1-BAPOF, RSA-APAC, BEST-PIN, etc. (free text, no strict constraint)
